title: OMGEval: An Open Multilingual Generative Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on a localized subset of open-ended questions where cultural references (e.g., festivals, foods, places, names) are manually adapted to specific cultural contexts. The models' outputs are then scored using GPT-4 as an adjudicator to measure their ability to understand and generate culturally appropriate content rather than defaulting to US-centric or English-centric norms.

Comparing the open-ended generative performance of language models across English and five non-English languages (Chinese, Russian, French, Spanish, Arabic) to quantify the performance disparity and English-centric bias in current LLMs.
